plain.li: [eating] {PAWN_nameDef} sets down {PAWN_possessive} spoon halfway through the meal. Something has to be said, and apparently it can't wait for dessert.
[eating] Between mouthfuls, {PAWN_nameDef} makes a point, then makes it again in case the chewing drowned it out.
[eating,!child] {PAWN_nameDef} waits until everyone has food in their mouths and can't interrupt.
[inbed] From under the blankets comes a voice. It's {PAWN_nameDef}, and {PAWN_pronoun} is not asleep.
[inbed,night] {PAWN_nameDef} sits up in bed in the dark and says it to the ceiling, loud enough for everyone.
[relaxing] {PAWN_nameDef} is supposed to be relaxing. {PAWN_nameDef} is instead composing a list of grievances.
[relaxing] In the middle of a rare quiet moment, {PAWN_nameDef} decides to spend it asking for something.
[work:Cooking] Over the hiss of the stove, {PAWN_nameDef} waves a ladle for emphasis.
[work:Cooking] {PAWN_nameDef} stops stirring, which is how everyone knows it's serious.
[work:Growing] Knee-deep in the field, {PAWN_nameDef} straightens up, wipes the dirt off {PAWN_possessive} hands, and speaks.
[work:Growing] {PAWN_nameDef} pauses between rows of crops, thinking about something other than crops for once.
[work:PlantCutting] Between swings of the axe, {PAWN_nameDef} says what's been on {PAWN_possessive} mind all morning.
[work:Mining] {PAWN_nameDef} comes up from the mine covered in rock dust, coughs twice, and makes a request.
[work:Mining] The pick stops. {PAWN_nameDef} leans on it and talks into the dark.
[work:Construction] {PAWN_nameDef} drives one last nail, steps back from the wall, and says the wall can wait.
[work:Construction] Up on the half-built frame, {PAWN_nameDef} shouts it down to whoever is listening.
[work:Hauling] {PAWN_nameDef} drops the load {PAWN_pronoun} was carrying, a little harder than necessary, and speaks up.
[work:Hauling] Halfway across the base with an armful of something heavy, {PAWN_nameDef} decides this is the moment.
[work:Cleaning] {PAWN_nameDef} leans on the broom. Sweeping gives a person time to think, and {PAWN_pronoun} has been thinking.
[work:Research] {PAWN_nameDef} looks up from the research bench with the expression of someone who has solved something, just not the research.
[work:Doctor] Still washing blood off {PAWN_possessive} hands, {PAWN_nameDef} has a word with whoever is nearest.
[work:Hunting] {PAWN_nameDef} comes back from the hunt with a carcass over one shoulder and a request on {PAWN_possessive} lips.
[work:Handling] {PAWN_nameDef} talks it through with a muffalo first. The muffalo agrees. Now it's the colony's turn.
[work:Warden] On the way back from the prison, {PAWN_nameDef} decides prisoners aren't the only ones with demands.
[work:Smithing] Over the clang of the anvil, {PAWN_nameDef} shouts something that might be a request.
[work:Tailoring] {PAWN_nameDef} talks around a mouthful of pins, which makes it hard to argue with.
[work:Art] {PAWN_nameDef} sets down the chisel and squints at the half-finished sculpture, then at everyone else.
[work:Crafting] {PAWN_nameDef} turns a half-made thing over in {PAWN_possessive} hands while making a case for something else entirely.
[work:Firefighter] Still smelling of smoke, {PAWN_nameDef} decides near-death is a good time to raise an issue.
[work:Childcare] With a child on each knee, {PAWN_nameDef} makes a request that nobody dares refuse in front of them.
[outside,rain] Standing in the rain, hood up, {PAWN_nameDef} makes a request that would go better indoors.
[outside,snow] {PAWN_nameDef} kicks a drift of snow off the path and decides to say it now, before the next drift.
[outside,night,clear] Under a sky full of stars, {PAWN_nameDef} says something that has nothing to do with the stars.
[inownroom] {PAWN_nameDef} calls someone into {PAWN_possessive} room to show them exactly what the problem is.
[indoors,storm] The walls shudder with thunder. {PAWN_nameDef} uses the moment of quiet after it.
[working,trait:Industrious|trait:HardWorker] {PAWN_nameDef} raises it without breaking stride. Work doesn't stop for wishes.
[working,trait:Industrious|trait:HardWorker] {PAWN_nameDef} asks while working, so nobody can say {PAWN_pronoun} slacked off to ask.
